about: What kind of game each surveyed level is, read by levels/lib/styles.mjs. Kept apart from the corpora (levels/corpus/levels-*.json) so a survey can be run again without losing it. A kind's bands come from its own levels only, never pooled with another kind. 'groups' gives a kind to a whole corpus ('ts') or to one of its groups ('hl/valve_dm'); null leaves it out. 'settings' sub-tags the exploration maps of Master Sword Rebirth by what the place is; a map not listed gets its setting from its measures (open-sky share: under 0.15 dungeon, 0.15 to 0.5 mixed, 0.5 and over outdoors) and says so. 'exclude' leaves single maps out, with the reason.

kinds.coop-campaign: A co-op campaign: one route from start to end, wide for four, open spaces for hordes, one-way drops, few choices (Left 4 Dead 2, Vermintide 2).
kinds.linear: A single-player linear level (Half-Life's campaign, the Hazard Course included).
kinds.arena: An arena for players against each other: loops, several routes, sightlines (The Specialists, Half-Life deathmatch).
kinds.exploration: RPG exploration: hubs, branches, dead ends with rewards (Master Sword Rebirth).
kinds.rp-city: A role-play city: streets and plazas, buildings entered by named doors (homes, shops, cells), several layers joined by stairs and lifts, lit for night (The Specialists' role-play cities).

groupsLeftOut.hl/cstrike: Counter-Strike: objective team play, not one of the four kinds asked for (closest to arena); kept out so it does not outvote The Specialists.
groupsLeftOut.hl/msc: Master Sword Classic: mostly the same maps as Master Sword Rebirth in an older build; counting both would vote twice.

msr.town: By name: Edana, Deralia and Helena are the game's towns; nightmare_edana is Edana's layout again.
msr.dungeon: Roofed floor (open-sky share under 0.15) or a name that says so (sewers, cave, crypt, catacombs, temple, under-). mscave is a cave by name though a quarter of it is under sky. islesofdread2 and undercliffs are roofed but very tall (headroom 1024 and 2021 units): caverns.
msr.mixed: Open-sky share 0.15 to 0.5: castles, keeps and forts with courtyards, a tower; mines is three-fifths under sky but a mine by name.
msr.outdoors: Open-sky share 0.5 and over, not a town.
msr.unclear: gatecity is a city by name but its walked floor is roofed and 347 m2; highlands_msc is highlands by name but roofed and 168 m2 walked; oceancrossing is a sea crossing 2344 units wide at the median whose sky the survey did not find. Left out of the setting bands, kept in exploration's.
